caption: If your peanut butter needs this many ingredients… 🤔🥄It’s not peanut butter. 🚫🥜 If we haven’t met, I’m Anjali. I run The Picky Eater and help busy families, health seekers, and everyday home cooks build a sustainable, joyful approach to clean eating 😊🥗 For over a decade, I’ve worked in nutrition coaching, recipe development, and health education, supporting thousands of families with simple, science-backed guidance that makes healthy living feel doable, without diets, guilt, or deprivation 💛📚 I’m a board-certified health coach, cookbook author, and mom of two. Through The Picky Eater, I focus on plant-based foods, smart ingredient choices, and balanced eating, with room for fun foods too 🌱👩‍🍳 Follow along for: • Practical nutrition tips for real life 📝 • Clean-eating frameworks without restriction • Easy, family-friendly recipes that actually taste great 🍽️ • Clear answers about food, weight, metabolism, and long-term health 🧠 If you want simple, plant-based eating without the stress 🧠✨ Check out The Picky Eater Mastery.
